title: Improve auto-save status indicator in DocumentEditor
action: Replace the temporary 'Saved' text with a proper status showing save state: idle → saving → saved with timestamp.
implementation: In DocumentEditor.tsx, replace the showSaved boolean state with a saveStatus state: 'idle' | 'saving' | 'saved'. Update handleEditorUpdate to set 'saving' immediately, then 'saved' after 1500ms debounce. Display shows last save time when saved (e.g. 'Saved at 10:45'). Add i18n keys: editorStatusSaving, editorStatusSavedAt, editorStatusIdle. Keep existing 2-second auto-hide behavior for 'saved' state but show timestamp briefly.
